fields.name: Amara Okafor
fields.bio: Dr. Okafor is a family doctor with 10 years of experience. She sees patients of all ages for checkups, colds and long-term care, and likes to take time to explain each step.

fields.name: Daniel Chen
fields.bio: Dr. Chen is a dermatologist with 12 years of experience treating adults and teens. He focuses on eczema, acne and skin checks, and keeps treatment plans simple.

fields.name: Sofia Martinez
fields.bio: Dr. Martinez is a pediatrician who cares for babies, children and teens. She does routine checkups, vaccines and visits for common childhood illnesses.

fields.name: Leila Haddad
fields.bio: Dr. Haddad works with adults dealing with anxiety, stress and low mood. Her visits are calm and private, and she helps patients build a plan that fits their life.

fields.name: Raj Patel
fields.bio: Dr. Patel is a cardiologist with 15 years of experience. He sees patients for chest pain, high blood pressure and heart checkups.

fields.name: Marcus Brown
fields.bio: Dr. Brown treats joint, bone and muscle problems. Many of his patients come in with sports injuries, back pain or knee pain.

fields.name: Emily Tremblay
fields.bio: Dr. Tremblay is a family doctor who sees patients for yearly checkups, minor illnesses and ongoing conditions like diabetes and asthma.

fields.name: Priya Sharma
fields.bio: Dr. Sharma is a dermatologist who treats rashes, acne and psoriasis. She also does mole checks and gives advice on daily skin care.

fields.name: Omar Khalil
fields.bio: Dr. Khalil is a pediatrician with 8 years of experience. He sees children for ear infections, fevers and growth checkups.

fields.name: Grace Liu
fields.bio: Dr. Liu is a cardiologist who helps patients manage cholesterol, palpitations and high blood pressure.

fields.name: Carlos Rivera
fields.bio: Dr. Rivera treats back, shoulder and knee pain. He works with patients on recovery plans after injuries and fractures.

fields.name: Hannah Wilson
fields.bio: Dr. Wilson supports patients with stress, sleep problems and burnout. She offers short-term counselling and follow-up visits.
